source.note: Generated from v1 by a script kept outside the repo; see README.md in this folder.

mappings: v1 parse result `{ ok: true, graph }` -> `{ kind: "ok" }`; `{ ok: false, kind, message }` -> `{ kind, message }`.
v1 serialize output: lines `class <ids> clickable` removed (v1 wrote Mermaid's own `clickable` class back; the port does not).
Op args are written in the port's signatures; the generator maps them to v1's positional arguments (addEdge(g, source, target, extra), groupNodes -> { graph, id }).
Ops returning `{ graph, id }` are compared on the graph; `expected` is the serialized code after the step.
Layout positions are top-left corners rounded to 2 decimals; `l` is the label tag. Place cases start from v1's dagre layout of the previous code (rounded), stored in `start`.
